[u][b]-- WELCOME ON BOARD, WELCOME TO DEEP ROCK GALACTIC! --[/b][/u]

[b]LIKE TO WORK HARD?[/b]
Look no further! Join us today, and you can work your a.. off every day for the rest of your life! (which wont be too long anyway) Payment is moderate (at best), but the colleagues are decent fellows, and we have a bar in the canteen as well!

[b]LIKE TO LIVE DANGEROUSLY?[/b]
Then you need US! We offer countless opportunities to put your life at stake for more profit. 

[b]EAGER TO MEET EXPECTATIONS?[/b]
We may not look like such, but our compny is known to be the most prudent and punctual workplace in the galaxy!

[i]Please note that missing our deadlines will literally cost you your life, but don't worry, our company covers the costs of your funeral, provided we find your body in the mines ever.[/i]

[b]WANT TO JOIN A SUPPORTIVE TEAM?[/b]
Do not hesitate and join US now, we are all dwarves of the ugly and hairy type, so we don't care how you look like and where do you come from, you will fit in nicely.

[b]CHOOSE YOUR PROFESSION TODAY![/b]
Leave your dull days sitting in an office behind, now we offer a chance to build your future in caves, lava caves, radioactive caves, infested caves... all kinds of caves! Want to mine gold, shoot aliens, light dark corners, fix things or just dig deep holes? All is possible with us, and even more! 

[i]Raise our profit now, and we also give you new weapons, costumes and perks! You might be doing the hardest job in the galaxy, but you will feel badass while doing so, we guarantee that![/i]

[b]GETTING INTERESTED?[/B]
All you need to do is sign our contract, pay the registration fee, and start working for us today! Endless fun is waiting for you till the end of your life! (which again might come sooner than expected). And never forget our motto:

[b]ROCK AND STONE BROTHERS, ROCK AND STONE![/b]
You make one suggesting for a new season in this game about breeding (Bosses 'N' Breedin') and you get banned from the discord. Thought it was a pretty good idea but I guess not.
I AM A DWARF AND I'M DIGGING A HOLE! DIGGY DIGGY HOLE! DIGGING A HOLE!
